senses.gloss:
केल् केल् [cf. Prākṛt कील् = क्रीड्], cl. 1. P.
केलति, to shake; to go or move, move
about, be frolicsome, sport.

केलक, अस्, m. a dancer, a tumbler, one who walks
or dances on the edge of a sword.
केलाय, nom. P. केलायति, -यितुम्, to sport, play.

केलि, इस् or ई, m. f. play, sport, amorous sport,
pastime, amusement; (इस्), f. the earth.
—केलि-कला,
f. amorous or sportive accents or address; sportive
skill, wantonness; the Vīṇā or lute of Sarasvatī.
—केलि-किल, अस्, m. the confidential companion of
the hero of a drama, in general a sort of buffoon;
one of Śiva's attendant demi-gods; (आ), f. an epithet
of Rati the wife of Kāma-deva, the god of love.
—केलि-कीर्ण, अस्, m. a camel.
—केलि-कुञ्चिका, f.
a wife's younger sister.
—केलि-कोष, अस्, m. an
actor, a dancer or tumbler.
—केलि-गृह or केलि-
निकेतन, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a private
apartment.
—केलि-नागर, अस्, m. a sensualist, an
enjoyer of worldly pleasures.
—केलि-पर, अस्, आ,
अम्, wanton, sportive.
—केलि-मण्डप, अस्, अम्,
m. n. or केलि-मन्दिर, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a
play-room.
—केलि-मुख, अस्, m. pastime, sport.
—केलि-रङ्ग, अस्, m. a pleasure-ground.
—केलि-
रैवतक, अम्, n. title of a treatise.
—केलि-वृक्ष,
अस्, m. a species of the Kadamba, commonly called
Kelikadamba (Nauclea Cordifolia), being abundant in
the scene of Kṛṣṇa's sports with the Gopīs.
—केलि-
शयन, अम्, n. a pleasure-couch, a sofa.
—केलि-
शुषि, इस्, f. the earth.
—केलि-सचिव, अस्, m. minister
of the sports, master of the revels.
—केलि-सदन,
अम्, n. a pleasure-house, a play-room.
—केलि-स्थली,
f. a place of pleasure.
—केली-पिक, अस्, m. a cuckoo
kept for pleasure.
—केली-वनी, f. a pleasure-park, a
pleasure-grove.

केलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, sportive; (अस्), m.
the tree Jonesia Aśoka.
केल केल or केलु, a particular number.
केलि-किल; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), wanton, arrogant.
